data.name: Black Demeter
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Eos, Captain!

After a lifetime aboard a starship, Gordale Vale finally sets foot on Eos, a tidally locked world with a scorched dayside, a frozen nightside, and a small band of twilight where life survives.

The previous settlers are fractured, the native Agrithans are close to open war and the mission AI that raised you is hiding something.

Turn movement into a weapon

Use your shield to convert incoming force into momentum. Enemy fire, grenades, and the environment can launch you across the battlefield, letting you chain speed into melee takedowns. Manage a shared energy pool so every fight becomes a choice between mobility, offense, defense, and tools. Backed by drones with customizable gear and your trusty gun, you will find that not all fights need to end lethally.

Explore the twilight ring

Eos is an open world where you explore the habitable zone between fire and ice.

  • Discover outposts, abandoned ruins, hidden caves, and strange wildlife

  • Break into living superorganisms that act like breathing dungeons

  • Take expeditions into the planet’s extremes, scavenge and confront what can survive them

  • Upgrade gear, drones, and shield tech with resources found in the wild

Uncover a cosmic-scale mystery

The truth behind your mission reaches far beyond the twilight zone. As loyalties fracture and hidden directives surface, Gordale Vale must confront a question no one aboard the vessel was allowed to ask:

What was humanity really sent here to do?

data.short_description: Black Demeter is an open-world sci-fi action-adventure on a planet in eternal twilight. Turn movement into a weapon and uncover the true cost of your mission.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-6300 (3.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 / Intel HD 4600 with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
